references.text: God created the sun and moon to rule over day and night, and to mark seasons and years. This relates to the blessing concerning crops that the cycles of the sun and moon bring forth.
The psalm describes how the moon was made to mark times, which corresponds with the monthly harvests mentioned in Moses' blessing.
This psalm praises God for blessing the earth's crops and fertility through the seasons, a theme similar to the gifts of the sun and moon in Joseph's blessing.
The immediate context shows the entire blessing over Joseph: the dew of heaven, the springs of the deep, and the best gifts of the earth.
Jacob's blessing over Joseph contains similar themes of blessings from above from the heavens and blessings from below from the deep, as well as the eternal gifts of the mountains.
